title: finding(plugin-form): the ADR-0092 D4 managed-object field lock is applied by the default object-form arm only — drawer, modal, tabbed, wizard and split draw editable inputs on a managed object
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named landing site and a render probe. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the `out_of_scope_findings` (class a) of the objectui#10475 dev report. The at-tier contract review of PR objectui#10556 checked it at source. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

ADR-0092 D4: a field of a managed object (e.g. `managedBy: 'better-auth'`) whose `userActions` do not grant the mode is locked in the form. On the default arm the generator stamps `managedBlanketLock` / `disabled` from `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances` (`ObjectForm.tsx`, `SimpleObjectForm`'s field generator). No other arm consults it: only `ObjectForm.tsx` calls `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances`.

## Probe (the dev's, relayed; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

The same scratch probe, at PR objectui#10556 head `6931629`: a `managedBy: 'better-auth'` object with no `userActions.create`, in create mode. The default arm drew 0 enabled inputs. Each of `drawer`, `modal`, `tabbed`, `wizard` and `split` drew 2.

## Reach

Reachable on any managed object opened in a non-default `formType`. The lock's own comment records it as UX only, with the server write guard as the boundary. So the effect is an editable-looking form whose save the server refuses, and the arms disagree with each other.

## Dedupe

Semantic search of this repo, including closed issues:
- 「managed object blanket field lock only default arm drawer modal resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances」 ⇒ 2 hits, both closed and about other defects: objectui#10254 (customFields members on the drawer and modal arms) and objectui#10216 (the drawer's collapse pair).

Dedupe words: `managed object lock formType drawer modal` · `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances sectioned arms` · `better-auth create affordance form arms` · `managedBlanketLock default arm only`
